page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6462C processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from other tenants on the host.

Given its balanced resource profile, the ecs.hfg8i.3xlarge is designed for workloads requiring a steady ratio of compute power to memory. Suitable applications include web serving, application servers, medium-sized databases, and general-purpose enterprise workloads that benefit from dedicated Intel Xeon processing cores and 10 Gbps network throughput.
